rawAnswer: {"findings":[{"kind":"defect","severity":"high","title":"Constructor selection order reversed for all types, not only suppressed","detail":"h8 changes the fallback constructor ordering from ThenByDescending(Parameters.Length) to ThenBy(Parameters.Length). The requirement does not ask for this. It applies to every [MessagePackObject] type, including types that do not suppress source generation. A type with both a public parameterless constructor and a public parameterized constructor now gets a generated formatter that uses the parameterless one. Before, the constructor with the most parameters was tried first, which is also what the dynamic resolver does. Members that only the larger constructor can set (get-only properties, readonly fields) may then not be restored on deserialization, and the deserializing-constructor diagnostics can change. The existing generator snapshots would also no longer match.
